entries.reason: The magenta target mask identifies the narrow facade left of the larger ochre neighbour. The native source crop shows a continuous warm cream-ochre wall without resolvable masonry joints; the focused target and both game views show a smooth pale cream wall on that same owner. Broad smooth render/cream family is supported. The game wall is paler and less ochre than the photograph, and the simplified windows, roof and ground-floor shapes are not accepted by this review.
